notes: Identity checked independently against body: title DYNAMICS OF ENGAGEMENT AND DISAFFECTION IN A SOCIAL STUDIES CLASSROOM CONTEXT; authors Ana M. Taboada Barber, Michelle M. Buehl, Jori S. Beck; Psychology in the Schools Vol. 54(7), 2017; DOI 10.1002/pits.22027. All match assigned replication reference. ResearchGate landing metadata names a different 2014 article; evidence used here is the uploaded primary article body. The supplied canonical file contains frozen web-parse excerpts, not a complete local PDF. The additional PDF parse stops in Participants. Figure 2 caption is present in HTML excerpts, but plotted coefficients and arrow-specific significance labels are not. No PDF path supplied; no rendering/acquisition performed. Targets identified by named predictor/outcome, fall/spring timing, and regression controlling fall outcome, never input order or numeric matching. Language status and interaction terms were dropped (p. 743). Candidate study sample 123 is not established as Figure 2 analytic N. No sums or df derivations performed. Table 4 n=118 is for different moderated mediation models and is not transferred. Numeric effects and same-test p bounds remain unresolved because the relevant figure content is absent from the excerpts; no claim of absence from the full article. Unassigned fields are placeholders. Authors explicitly describe the null relationship as similar to Skinner et al.; success reflects narrative agreement, not inference from significance.
